description: WYGWYL Canonical Cast, Proportion Normalization, Aspect-Compensated Piece-Scaling & Locomotion Solver Library across all 14 poems

global_aspect_compensation_formula.formula: if (w/h > 0.75) multiplier = clamp(1.0 / sqrt(1.0 + 1.35 * pow((w/h) - 0.50, 2)), 0.36, 0.82); else multiplier = 1.0
global_aspect_compensation_formula.single_part_torso_rule: Scale single-part torso cards by anatomical torso height (canonical_height_stage_ratio * 0.32 * stage_H) rather than full standing figure bbox height.

child_traveler_ghost.name: Child Traveler / Young Poet / Ghost Child (Age 7, 5.2-Head 0.68x Scale)
child_traveler_ghost.character_role: Age 6–7 Child Traveler (Poem 06), Ghost Child (Poem 02, 05, 09), and Young Poet (Poem 02, 13). Solved at 5.2-head child anatomy = 0.68x adult height (0.37 stage ratio) so child cutouts never scale up to giant adult height.

aspect_compensation.formula: child_scale = 0.68 * adult_scale; aspect_mult = (w/h > 0.75) ? clamp(1.0 / sqrt(1.0 + 1.35 * pow((w/h) - 0.50, 2)), 0.36, 0.82) : 1.0
aspect_compensation.child_bug_solved: In v2/poses/young_poet.child_clothes, crouch.png (491px) and head.front.png (447px) had adult pixel dimensions. This solver locks standing child height to 0.37 * stage_H, crouched child to 0.25 * stage_H, and prone child to 0.15 * stage_H.
